summary: Suggest Number Series with Copilot in Business Central (2024 release wave 2) is demoed for generating number series for a record, a module, or a whole new company, and for preparing existing series for the next year. The demo covers prompt guides, year numbers in series, and automatic updates to setup pages.
overview:
The video, published 2024-10-08, shows how Copilot in Business Central can generate new number series, modify existing ones, or prepare them for the next year. This reduces the manual work needed during a new implementation, recurring maintenance, or rollout of a new module or company.

The demo starts with a service management module rollout and generates a series for the contract credit memo. It then prepares existing series for the next year and generates a complete set of series for a new company with the user experience set to premium. The presenter warns that AI generated content might be incorrect and that wrong suggestions may need to be deleted by hand.
key_points: Copilot can generate or modify number series for a specific record, a module, or an entire company, using a customizable prompt.
The number series dialog includes prompt guides for common tasks: creating series for a new company, preparing series for the next year, and modifying existing series.
Prompts can add requirements. In the demo, the prompt explicitly asked for the last two digits of the year (24), and the generated series included it.
When a suggested series is kept, Copilot also updates the related setup page, for example service management setup.
In the next-year demo, Copilot created an additional number series line with a starting date of 1 January 2025, following the same pattern as the original series.
For a new company, the scope of generated series follows the user experience setting. A premium company gets series for all modules.
AI generated content might be incorrect. In the demo, Copilot also suggested a sales credit memo series that was not requested, and the presenter deleted it before keeping the suggestion.
